conflicts.description: Contradictory reports on the effect of V addition on oxidation resistance of Fe-Al alloys.

evidence.quote: While Savitskii et al. [26] reported that the oxidation resistance is good up to 1200 /C14 C [26], Culbertson & Kortovich found that V degrades the oxidation resistance of Fe 3Al already at 816 /C14 C [31].
